Class Course

java.lang.Object
project.models.others.Course
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class Course extends Object implements Serializable
A university course with its schedule, marks per student, and assigned instructors. Multiple teachers can be attached (e.g. one for lectures, another for practice sessions).
